prompt :
Create an ultra-realistic premium editorial portrait using the PROVIDED PERSON REFERENCE IMAGE as the STRICT IDENTITY REFERENCE.

The supplied reference image controls the identity, facial appearance, hairstyle, hair texture, skin tone, facial proportions, body proportions, and recognizable characteristics of the MAIN PERSON.

IMPORTANT:

Preserve the exact recognizable identity of the supplied person.

Do not replace the face with a generic model.

Do not redesign the person's facial features.

Do not change the person's age, skin tone, face shape, eye shape, nose, lips, eyebrows, or distinctive characteristics.

Create ONE SINGLE VERTICAL COMPOSITE IMAGE divided into TWO HALVES by a dramatic irregular vertical torn-paper transition.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LEFT HALF — REAL PHOTOGRAPH

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

On the LEFT side, show the supplied person as a completely photorealistic, high-end fashion portrait.

The person should look exactly like the supplied reference identity.

Pose:

- confident relaxed standing pose

- upper-body / three-quarter portrait

- face turned slightly toward the camera

- calm, confident editorial expression

- natural posture

- realistic human anatomy

Wardrobe:

Create a sophisticated modern fashion outfit inspired by the target image:

a fitted black top underneath an elegant warm rust / burnt-orange blazer or jacket.

Preserve realistic fabric texture, stitching, folds, shadows and natural clothing behavior.

HAIR:

Maintain the person's reference hairstyle and hair characteristics as accurately as possible.

Individual hair strands must be visible.

Natural volume and realistic movement.

LIGHTING:

Soft natural daylight.

Subtle cinematic highlights.

Realistic facial shadows.

Natural skin texture.

Professional fashion photography lighting.

BACKGROUND:

Modern contemporary architectural environment with a large glass-and-steel building facade.

Tall vertical windows and structural lines behind the subject.

Soft realistic depth of field.

Clean urban editorial atmosphere.

The LEFT HALF must look like a genuine professional photograph.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

RIGHT HALF — HAND-DRAWN COMIC VERSION

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

On the RIGHT side, recreate the SAME PERSON as a sophisticated monochrome hand-drawn fashion illustration.

The illustrated person must clearly resemble the exact person from the supplied reference image.

Preserve:

- same face identity

- same hairstyle

- same facial proportions

- same approximate pose

- same body proportions

- same clothing silhouette

Transform ONLY the visual medium into a detailed black-and-white editorial comic illustration.

Illustration style:

- hand-drawn ink artwork

- sophisticated fashion illustration

- clean black outlines

- subtle grayscale shading

- realistic anatomy

- elegant sketchbook quality

- expressive facial details

- carefully drawn hair strands

- professional graphic-novel / fashion-comic aesthetic

Do NOT make it childish.

Do NOT make it cartoonish.

Do NOT use anime style.

Do NOT use exaggerated comic proportions.

The illustrated person should feel like a high-fashion black-and-white graphic novel character based directly on the real person.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CENTER TRANSITION — TORN PAPER

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a dramatic irregular VERTICAL TORN-PAPER DIVISION between the real photograph and the illustration.

The split should NOT be a clean straight line.

It must look like REAL PAPER being torn vertically from the top to the bottom.

Create:

- irregular jagged edges

- uneven ripped-paper fibers

- realistic paper thickness

- subtle white paper fibers

- tiny torn fragments

- slight shadow along the ripped edge

- natural imperfect tearing

- convincing physical paper texture

The torn edge should reveal a clear transition from:

PHOTOREALISTIC PERSON → HAND-DRAWN ILLUSTRATION.

The transition must feel physically layered and believable.

Do not use a simple digital split-screen effect.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ILLUSTRATION DETAILS

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Add tasteful hand-drawn doodle elements around the illustrated half, similar to a creative fashion sketchbook:

small cloud

small stars

small heart

simple coffee cup

small vintage camera

tiny decorative sparkles

These elements must be black-and-white hand-drawn ink doodles.

Keep them subtle and aesthetically balanced.

Do not overcrowd the image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MATCHING BETWEEN BOTH HALVES

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The REAL and ILLUSTRATED versions must represent the SAME PERSON.

Their:

- face

- hairstyle

- pose

- clothing

- body proportions

- overall silhouette

must visually correspond across the torn-paper boundary.

The left side is REAL.

The right side is the HAND-DRAWN artistic interpretation of that same person.

Make the transition look intentional and seamless.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

VISUAL STYLE

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Luxury fashion editorial.

Creative advertising campaign.

Premium magazine photography.

Photorealistic + hand-drawn mixed-media artwork.

Modern artistic portrait.

Sophisticated minimal composition.

High-end visual storytelling.

The final image should look like a professionally designed fashion campaign rather than an ordinary AI-generated image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CAMERA

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Eye-level camera.

Straight-on perspective.

Medium / three-quarter portrait.

Natural lens perspective.

No fisheye distortion.

No extreme wide-angle distortion.

Sharp focus on the main subject.

Realistic depth of field.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

COLOR

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LEFT SIDE:

Natural full color.

Warm realistic skin tones.

Burnt-orange / rust clothing.

Neutral architectural background.

RIGHT SIDE:

Strict black-and-white / grayscale.

White paper background.

Black ink outlines.

Soft gray shading.

Keep the two visual worlds clearly distinguishable.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

OUTPUT QUALITY

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Ultra-photorealistic.

Extremely detailed.

Professional editorial quality.

Natural skin pores.

Realistic hair strands.

Detailed clothing texture.

Highly detailed ink illustration.

Fine paper fibers.

Accurate anatomy.

Clean composition.

Premium commercial advertising quality.

TARGET OUTPUT RESOLUTION:

16K ULTRA HIGH RESOLUTION

15360 × 8640 pixels

approximately 132.7 million pixels.

If the image-generation system cannot natively generate 15360 × 8640 pixels, generate at the highest available resolution while preserving maximum detail, composition, identity consistency, and fine texture, optimized for high-quality 16K upscaling.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

STRICT NEGATIVE PROMPT

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

different person, changed identity, generic face, face replacement, face swap, identity drift, altered facial structure, different hairstyle, different hair color, different skin tone, different age, inconsistent face, two different people, duplicate person, extra person, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed hands, bad anatomy, distorted body, unrealistic proportions, plastic skin, wax skin, CGI, 3D render, anime, childish cartoon, low-quality cartoon, colorful illustration, straight split line, clean digital divider, smooth transition, messy torn paper, fake paper edge, excessive doodles, cluttered background, distorted architecture, blurry face, low resolution, oversharpening, excessive HDR, artificial skin, unrealistic clothing, random text, typography, logo, watermark, signature, captions.

AI Character Consistency Workflow 🎬
Keep the same character consistent across different outfits, poses, environments, lighting, and camera angles — while maintaining their identity and facial features.

created with @grok 
prompt :
**REFERENCE IMAGE 1 = CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE**

**REFERENCE IMAGE 2 = WORKFLOW / LAYOUT REFERENCE**
Create an **exactly structured professional AI character-consistency workflow board based on Reference Image 2**, while completely replacing the original person/character with the person from **Reference Image 1**.
**CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — ABSOLUTE PRIORITY:**

Reference Image 1 is the only source of truth for the character's identity. Preserve the exact facial identity, facial structure, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, hairstyle, hair texture, age, body proportions and overall recognizable appearance of the person in Reference Image 1.
The character must remain **the exact same person in every generated image**. Do not redesign, beautify, age, de-age, masculinize, feminize or otherwise alter the character's identity.
**REFERENCE IMAGE 2 — STRUCTURE LOCK:**

Reproduce the visual structure of Reference Image 2: a dark professional node-based AI workflow interface, with the character reference/input panel on the left, a central prompt/instruction/code panel, and multiple generated result panels arranged vertically on the right. Preserve the same overall composition, spacing, connecting lines, panel arrangement, technical/editorial aesthetic and visual hierarchy.

### LEFT — CHARACTER REFERENCE

Display Reference Image 1 as the main character input/reference image inside a clean portrait frame on the left side.
Add subtle professional interface details around it, making it look like a real AI image-generation workflow.

### CENTER — GENERATION PROMPT / CONTROL NODE

Create a realistic technical prompt/control panel containing instructions for maintaining character consistency.
The visible workflow concept should communicate:
**IDENTITY LOCK**

**FACE CONSISTENCY**

**HAIR CONSISTENCY**

**BODY PROPORTION CONSISTENCY**

**OUTFIT CONTROL**

**POSE CONTROL**

**LIGHTING CONTROL**

**CAMERA CONTROL**

**ENVIRONMENT CONTROL**
Connect the character reference and control/prompt node to the output images using multiple thin curved workflow lines, matching the visual style of Reference Image 2.

### RIGHT — MULTIPLE CHARACTER OUTPUTS

Generate **8 separate fashion/editorial character images** arranged in **4 rows × 2 columns**, matching the output arrangement in Reference Image 2.
Every output must feature **the exact same person from Reference Image 1**.
Each image should show a different pose, camera angle, outfit variation and environment while maintaining absolute identity consistency.
Suggested variations:
**01 — Full-body standing fashion portrait**

Different outfit, confident standing pose.
**02 — Three-quarter fashion portrait**

Slightly different pose and camera angle.
**03 — Walking pose**

Natural movement, full body visible.
**04 — Seated editorial pose**

Relaxed cinematic fashion composition.
**05 — Side-angle portrait**

Different camera perspective while preserving identity.
**06 — Dynamic fashion pose**

Natural body movement and realistic clothing behavior.
**07 — Close/medium portrait**

Strong facial detail and consistent identity.
**08 — Full-body cinematic shot**

Different environment and pose, same character.

### CONSISTENCY RULE

**DO NOT create eight different people.**

All eight outputs must unmistakably represent the **same individual from Reference Image 1**.
Only change:

-  clothing 
-  pose 
-  camera angle 
-  environment 
-  lighting 
-  composition 

Never change:

-  facial identity 
-  facial proportions 
-  hairstyle unless specifically requested 
-  skin tone 
-  age 
-  body proportions 
-  distinctive facial characteristics 

### VISUAL STYLE

Premium professional AI-generation workflow interface, dark technical canvas, subtle grid background, thin curved colored connection lines, realistic UI nodes, sophisticated cinematic design, clean spacing, high-end creative-AI laboratory aesthetic.
The generated character images should be **photorealistic, cinematic and highly detailed**, with realistic skin texture, natural hair, accurate anatomy, realistic fabric behavior, physically coherent lighting and professional photography.
**IMPORTANT:** Reference Image 1 controls **WHO the character is**. Reference Image 2 controls **HOW the workflow board looks**. Do not mix their identities. Do not use the person from Reference Image 2. Replace that person completely with the character from Reference Image 1.
**TEXT/UI:** Keep the interface visually realistic and organized. Avoid random gibberish text. Use clean readable labels such as **CHARACTER REFERENCE, IDENTITY LOCK, PROMPT, OUTPUTS, CONSISTENCY**.
**FINAL RESULT:** A polished viral-style **AI character consistency workflow board**, visually similar in structure to Reference Image 2, but featuring the user's own character from Reference Image 1 across all generated outputs.

𝗡𝗼 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 "𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗺𝗲 𝗯𝗿𝗼", 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗵 𝗱𝗼𝗲𝘀 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗹𝗶𝗲!

Where does the entire autonomous agent circus actually hit a wall?

Say my agent hires another agent to write a thousand lines of code or crunch heavy financial data. The provider hands over the file and demands payment.

Here is the life-or-death question:  
How do you know the output is legitimate execution and not random hallucinated garbage?

Who checks it? A human? If I still have to sit there and review code line by line, why call it autonomous in the first place? I might as well do the damn job myself.

Every platform in this space got stuck in that exact swamp.  
Except 𝗧𝗲𝗿𝗺𝗶𝗫 built one specific feature that actually cleans up the mess:  
𝗩𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝘂𝘁𝗲 𝘃𝗶𝗮 𝘇𝗸𝗩𝗠 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗧𝗘𝗘 𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗹𝗮𝘃𝗲𝘀.

How it works:

1. 𝘇𝗸𝗩𝗠 (𝗭𝗲𝗿𝗼-𝗞𝗻𝗼𝘄𝗹𝗲𝗱𝗴𝗲 𝗩𝗶𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀)  
The provider agent does not get to say trust me, my code ran fine.  
The computation runs inside a zkVM, spitting out a cryptographic proof. That proof hash gets committed on-chain.  
The client agent or smart contract never reruns the heavy job. It just verifies the proof in milliseconds. If the math checks out, the execution was 100% correct.

2. 𝗧𝗘𝗘 (𝗧𝗿𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗘𝘅𝗲𝗰𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗘𝗻𝘃𝗶𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀)  
For sensitive data or workloads where ZK is too heavy, the job runs inside isolated hardware enclaves. Even the server hosting the machine cannot tamper with the run or cheat the result.

Why this changes everything:

Web3 always loved chanting "Don't Trust, Verify".  
Yet AI agents have been running on pure "Trust me bro". There was zero way to verify output automatically.

With this mechanism in @termix_ai  :  
• Escrow stops waiting on human eyes. The moment cryptographic proof hits the chain, stablecoins (𝗨𝗦𝗗𝗖 or 𝗨𝗦𝗗𝗧) release automatically.  
• Try to submit fake output or cut corners? The proof fails, you get zero pay, and your staked capital gets slashed on-chain.

Talk is cheap. The difference between a real system and clownery is putting math and hardware proofs in the middle so two machines can do business without scamming each other.

Feature 9: He showed him computer use — the capability most users are afraid to try.

He told him computer use is the headline capability of GPT-6 Astra — the feature OpenAI demonstrated most prominently at launch — and the one most ChatGPT users haven't tried once in 9 days.

He told him the hesitation is understandable. "Let the AI use my computer" sounds risky. The user imagines the AI clicking the wrong button, submitting the wrong form, or navigating to the wrong website. The fear keeps most users in the text box — asking Astra to describe what to do instead of asking Astra to do it.

He showed him the safety model. Astra's computer use operates in a sandboxed environment — the AI interacts with a virtual browser, not with the user's actual desktop. The user watches the actions in real time. The user can pause or stop at any moment. The AI asks for confirmation before taking consequential actions — submitting forms, making purchases, sending messages. The system is designed for observation and intervention, not blind trust.

He demonstrated. "Go to my Google Calendar. Find my first meeting tomorrow. Open the shared agenda document. Summarize the key discussion points." Astra opened a browser. Navigated to Google Calendar. Found the meeting. Clicked the agenda link. Read the document. Summarized the discussion points. Four steps across 2 applications — completed in 30 seconds while the user watched.

He told him computer use is nearly 2x faster on Astra than on the previous model. The underlying infrastructure has been optimized so that even GPT-5.6 runs computer tasks roughly 60% faster. The speed makes computer use practical — a 30-second automated workflow replaces a 3-minute manual process. The gap between "let me do it myself" and "let Astra do it" narrows to the point where delegation is faster than execution.

He told him to start with low-stakes tasks — calendar checks, research workflows, price comparisons, form pre-fills — and build comfort before delegating anything consequential. The trust builds through observation. The productivity unlocks through delegation. The capability that most users are afraid to try is the capability that saves the most time once the fear subsides.

This paper is definitely one of the cleanest takes on offline RL we’ve come across recently.

We’ve all seen how messy the balance is between staying on-distribution and actually maximizing reward. 

Most people either throw in awkward penalties or just use diffusion models and live with painful sampling latencies.

They treat behavioral constraints and value optimization as motion fields in action space, blend them, and bake the whole thing into a one step generator. 

You get the expressiveness of a generative model without having to wait on multi step denoising at test time, just a single forward pass.

They tested it on 73 tasks across D4RL and OGBench and took the top average rank against some serious diffusion and flow baselines. 

Definitely worth reading if you care about fast continuous control: https://t.co/FWtPTmNFiK
